def _html_safe_json(value: Any) -> str:
    """Serialize a value to JSON that is safe to embed inside a <script> tag."""
    return (
        json.dumps(value)
        .replace("<", "\\u003c")
        .replace(">", "\\u003e")
        .replace("&", "\\u0026")
    )


def _js_string_escape(value: str) -> str:
    """Escape a value to be embedded inside a single-quoted JS string in a <script> tag."""
    return (
        value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace("'", "\\'")
        .replace("<", "\\u003c")
        .replace(">", "\\u003e")
        .replace("&", "\\u0026")
    )

def _html_safe_json(value: Any) -> str:
    """Serialize a value to JSON that is safe to embed inside a <script> tag."""
    return (
        json.dumps(value)
        .replace("<", "\\u003c")
        .replace(">", "\\u003e")
        .replace("&", "\\u0026")
    )


def _js_string_escape(value: str) -> str:
    """Escape a value to be embedded inside a single-quoted JS string in a <script> tag."""

        value.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace("'", "\\'")

        .replace(">", "\\u003e")
        .replace("&", "\\u0026")
